entries.description: Authenticated producer credentials, signed batch chains, stable retries, and resumable delta transfer.
security_claims: authenticated producer provenance when an explicitly trusted canonical credential lineage, revocation state, signatures, and chain predecessors verify
exclusions: a producer-supplied credential is not a trust anchor
unsigned imported content does not become authenticated producer evidence

entries.description: One random archive epoch secret wrapped to recipients with per-object compartment keys derived locally by HKDF.
security_claims: provider-blind storage when no service recipient slot exists
epoch-wide cryptographic erasure when every recoverable epoch secret is destroyed
exclusions: does not provide selective per-object cryptographic erasure

entries.description: Random per-object data-encryption keys and wrapped-key inventory for selective cryptographic erasure.
security_claims: selective cryptographic erasure when every wrapped-key, backup, and plaintext copy is destroyed
exclusions: requires deployment-specific key custody, backup, and recovery operations

entries.description: Independent head checkpoints or witness signatures for rollback detection beyond valid-prefix integrity.
security_claims: rollback detection relative to trusted witness checkpoints

entries.description: Live archive signer rotation and preauthorized successor activation.
security_claims: verifiable signer continuity across authorized rotation or succession

entries.description: External key-management integration with pinned key identifiers, custody boundaries, and recovery claims.
security_claims: key operations are delegated to the declared external custody boundary
exclusions: does not imply HSM, jurisdictional, or operator-resistance properties not stated by the deployment
